name: next-best-prompt-mcp-remote
description: Remote (always-on) MCP server for the closure_scheduler v0.5.5 end-of-turn rule. Serves the rule over Streamable HTTP via mcp-handler on Vercel. No secrets, no compute, stateless. The package name is kept because it is the Vercel project name; it served the v0.3 next_best_prompt incumbent until 2026-07-30.
